Corrigendum for Project Staff Requirement
This is in reference to research project “Tele-Health Screening and Management
for Non-Communicable Diseases”, advertisement are published for the post of
Project Technical Support-III. This is to inform that the last date to apply for the said
posts is extended till 16th May 2025 (Friday).
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
